rules.rule: If an image has many competing elements, remove those that do not earn attention to restore a single subject.
rules.evidence: Simplification is the practice of deciding what the attention is being spent on, by removing the things that are spending it without earning it.

rules.rule: If density is the intended subject (like a crowd), do not remove elements as this would reduce the content itself.
rules.evidence: When density is the subject — a city, a crowd, an economy, a festival — reducing it would be reducing the content.
